Stores a player name on this device only. Same model as HMCL / Fold Craft Launcher offline accounts. It does not join servers that require a paid account.
LittleSkin is a third-party skin site, not official Microsoft / Mojang login. The API address is prefilled from the LittleSkin manual.

Fold Craft Launcher also accepts an authlib-injector URL. The password is sent only to that server. API Location Indication is supported (for example littleskin.cn). This is still not official Microsoft login.
Manage Minecraft Java accounts on Android, download versions through BMCLAPI, and launch an installed game.

Game files default to BMCLAPI (https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com), operated by bangbang93. HMCL and Fold Craft Launcher use this community mirror. If a file fails, FCP falls back to Mojang: piston-meta.mojang.com, piston-data.mojang.com, launchermeta.mojang.com, libraries.minecraft.net, and resources.download.minecraft.net. This screen keeps the BMCLAPI credit.

Offline accounts and LittleSkin (Yggdrasil / authlib-injector) are supported. LittleSkin launch adds authlib-injector; if the jar is not on the device yet, FCP downloads it from BMCLAPI and then from the GitHub release. Advanced mode accepts another Yggdrasil server. Official Microsoft login is not in this version: there is no Mojang client-id application and no other launcher\'s Azure app is reused.

Official Microsoft login, multiplayer, and the Windows / macOS / Linux desktop app come later. This package includes the Fold Craft Launcher 1.3.4.4 renderer and bridge libraries. The Java runtime is downloaded on first launch: Java 17 from Pojav\'s public JRE, Java 8 and 21 from the runtime inside the FCL package. Missing files are still written to the log.

FCP Launcher is released under GNU GPL-3.0. Download, account, and launch arguments follow HMCL and Fold Craft Launcher (both GPL-3.0). Plain Craft Launcher source is not included.
